design.cache_isolation: Fresh config/transcripts/task files; intentionally shared native home catalogue/cache outside prompt timing; remote cache/load/sampling uncontrolled.
design.sampling_seed: No provider sampling seed; synthetic fixture inputs seeded by paired repeat.
design.source_validation: Each own venv verified from outside repo; exact HEAD and clean runtime required before launch; runtime semantic/content hashes stable before/after every cell.

analysis.caveat: Descriptive fixed-source paired observations, not a causal performance estimate; remote sampling/load/cache and local scheduling remain uncontrolled.
